description: Read-only price quote for a pump.fun (PumpSwap) AMM swap on a GRADUATED coin. No signing or tx sending. One of inputMint/outputMint must be wSOL (So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112). Returns amountOut, priceImpactBps, route, expiresAtMs. Pricing follows PumpSwap exactly: the quote side is the EFFECTIVE reserve, pool_quote_token_account.amount + pool.virtual_quote_reserves (a SIGNED i128, commonly negative because PumpSwap v2 trades keep waiting protocol and creator fees in the vault and subtract them there), while the base side is the raw pool_base_token_account.amount, unchanged. Coins still on the bonding curve have no pool, so use get_bonding_curve instead. The quote is a snapshot: honour expiresAtMs and re-quote after it. Use this to size a trade on a graduated coin, or to measure its pool depth, before executing anywhere.

amountIn.description: Input amount in raw base units (lamports for SOL).

name: pumpfun_quote_swap

amountOut.description: Expected output in raw base units (lamports when the output is wSOL), fee-inclusive.

base_reserve.description: Raw base vault balance (pool_base_token_account.amount). Unaffected by virtual reserves.

effective_quote_reserve.description: quote_reserve + virtual_quote_reserves. The reserve the quote is actually priced against. Never negative (the program guarantees it); may be below quote_reserve.

expiresAtMs.description: Unix ms after which this quote is stale and must be re-requested.

priceImpactBps.description: Execution price vs. the pool spot price, in basis points. Spot is measured against the effective quote reserve (vault + virtual), so virtual liquidity correctly reads as depth rather than as impact.

quote_reserve.description: Raw quote vault balance (pool_quote_token_account.amount), before virtual reserves. Includes protocol and creator fees waiting for a sweep, so it overstates liquidity on its own; price on effective_quote_reserve.

route.description: PumpSwap pool address the quote was priced on.

virtual_quote_reserves.description: Pool.virtual_quote_reserves, a SIGNED i128 serialized as a decimal string. Positive values add depth held outside the vault; negative values remove fees that sit in the vault waiting for a sweep (common since the PumpSwap v2 trades). Parse it as a signed integer: never unsigned, never clamped to 0, never absolute-valued.

title: Swap Quote (Read-Only)
